subject: Spectral Health: tenant-scoped deletion runbook and evidence request
messages:
From: Claire Brooks <claire.brooks@auditlab.io>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: Spectral Health Compliance <compliance@spectralhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Spectral - tenant-scoped deletion runbook + evidentiary artifacts request

Neha,

Following up from our call last week — the SOC 2 auditor needs a clear, customer-scoped runbook and sample artifacts for Spectral Health's request to limit session/audit logs to a 90-day TTL for one tenant. Specifically they want:

- A short runbook that describes the deletion workflow for tenant-scoped logs (trigger, selectors, retention tag removal, delete job cadence, verification).
- Sample proof-of-delete output (hashes or IDs) from a recent deletion job (CSV snippet is fine).
- Evidence that KMS key rotation and object tombstone creation occurred as part of the workflow.
- Any relevant SIG/CAIQ guidance notes you rely on for the exception (if you map controls to the exception).

Can you confirm whether we can produce a scoped deletion runbook + 3 example proof files by EOD next Friday (2028-07-09)? The auditor has flagged this as a high-priority item for the SOC 2 readiness review.

Attached is Spectral's compliance questionnaire excerpt for context.

Attachments: spectral_data_retention_q1.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Claire Brooks
Senior IT Auditor, AuditLab
claire.brooks@auditlab.io
+1 415 555 0192
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Claire Brooks <claire.brooks@auditlab.io>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 2 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Spectral - tenant-scoped deletion runbook + evidentiary artifacts request

Claire — thanks for the clear list. We can support this but need to coordinate owners and scope. Looping in Rishi (runtime + infra) and Marissa (security PM) to own deliverables.

Proposed immediate plan: 
1) Rishi to produce a concise tenant deletion runbook (1-2 pages) describing selectors, scheduled delete job, verification checks, and backup/replication implications.
2) Marissa to collate CAIQ/SIG notes and map the control references we rely on for this exception.
3) I will assemble the proof artifacts (sample CSV with delete markers, KMS rotation logs, and a short attestation note).

Can Rishi and Marissa confirm feasibility for the requested EOD 2028-07-09 delivery? If it helps, I suggest a 30-min sync tomorrow to align scope and the exact CSV columns the auditor wants.

I've attached our internal evidence checklist to speed collection.

Attachments: redwood_evidence_checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
From: Spectral Health Compliance <compliance@spectralhealth.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: Claire Brooks <claire.brooks@auditlab.io>
Date: Mon, 2 Jul 2028 11:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Spectral - tenant-scoped deletion runbook + evidentiary artifacts request

Neha — thank you. A few clarifications from our side (auditor asked us to confirm):

- The auditor prefers that the sample proof-of-delete includes an irreversible hash for deleted object IDs, plus the timestamp of deletion and the job run ID.
- They also want evidence of KMS key rotation events correlated to the deletion window (even if key rotations are system-wide).
- If Redwood can provide a short note about how prefix/KV cache invalidation is handled when logs are deleted, that will close a potential gap the auditor flagged.

We're under a client deadline so would appreciate the July 9th timeline. If you can share a drive link to the artifacts as they become available that would be ideal.

Thanks — happy to join a sync if useful.

— Spectral Compliance Team
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Claire Brooks <claire.brooks@auditlab.io>, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 2 Jul 2028 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Spectral - tenant-scoped deletion runbook + evidentiary artifacts request

Thanks Neha / Claire — plan and ETA below.

Short plan (deliverables):
- Tenant Deletion Runbook (rishi_malhotra): 1 single-page runbook + appendix listing job IDs and selectors.
- Sample proof-of-delete (rishi_malhotra): CSV snippet containing object_id, hashed_id (sha256), deleted_at (ISO8601), delete_job_id.
- KMS rotation evidence (marissa_cole): key rotation event log extract and mapping to deletion window.
- Control mapping (marissa_cole): CAIQ/SIG notes and short mapping doc.
- Attestation (neha_kapoor): 1-paragraph attestation describing scope and that the deletion was tenant-scoped (no cross-tenant impact).

Timeline: initial artifacts (runbook + CSV sample + KMS excerpt) to Drive link by 2028-07-06 COB; full package + control mapping and attestation by 2028-07-09 COB.

Drive location (draft): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cSampleEvidenceLink

Attachments we'll drop in the draft folder: sample-delete-log-20280630.csv
